create_NodeSet: create a NodeSet with n_node count and feature arrays for graph nodes
create_EdgeSet: create an EdgeSet with n_edge count, sender/receiver indices, and feature arrays
create_Context: create a Context with n_graph count and global feature arrays for the graph
create_TypedGraph: create a TypedGraph with a context, node sets, and edge sets mapping
lookup_edge_by_name: lookup an EdgeSet by name using TypedGraph edge_by_name method
